title: On Annoying everybody in the street
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：annoy　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 annoy 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the observer ① annoyed everybody in the street on the same day, and every assistant in the observatory said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the observer ② annoys everybody in the street before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ annoy everybody in the street at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ annoyed everybody in the street before — a line in the log for November 1967 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Annoying everybody in the street on the same day, the observer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the lens at the far dome, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ annoy the people asleep upstairs before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Annoy the people asleep upstairs at once and never mention it again.

By 1980 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the log, and a new assistant from the next observatory ⑧ annoys the people asleep upstairs on the same day every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the dome, said nothing at all; she simply  annoyed everybody in the street again when nobody else would.

To annoy everybody in the street, my mother said in 1985, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the observatory remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the observatory forgets, somebody annoys everybody in the street before dawn again and somebody must annoy everybody in the street on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 惹恼（一般过去式 annoyed everybody in the street：1973 年观测员头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 惹恼（一般现在 annoys everybody in the street：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 惹恼（不定式 to annoy everybody in the street：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 惹恼（过去完成时 had annoyed everybody in the street：1967 年十一月的观测记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 惹恼（动名词 annoying everybody in the street 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 打扰（annoy the people asleep upstairs：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去打扰楼上睡着的人）
G. v. 打扰（annoy the people asleep upstairs：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 惹恼（后段两处：新来的助手照例 annoys the people asleep upstairs，而母亲又一次 annoyed everybody in the street）

items.q: to annoy everybody in the street
annoyed everybody in the street before
annoy the people asleep upstairs before dawn
annoy the people asleep upstairs at once
annoys the people asleep upstairs on the same day

answers.why: annoy 意为“惹恼”，1973 年观测员当天就惹恼街上的每一个人，那是观测站里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 annoyed。
annoy 意为“惹恼”，自那以后观测员天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 annoys。
annoy 意为“惹恼”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯惹恼街上的每一个人”，此处为不定式 to annoy everybody in the street。
annoy 意为“惹恼”，观测记录里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1980 年之前就有人惹恼过，故用过去完成时 had annoyed。
annoy 意为“惹恼”，观测员说“惹恼街上的每一个人这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 annoying everybody in the street 作主语。
annoy 意为“打扰”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去打扰楼上睡着的人”，should ever 之后用原形 annoy the people asleep upstairs。
annoy 意为“打扰”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻打扰楼上睡着的人（annoy the people asleep upstairs at once），以后再也不要提起。
annoy 意为“惹恼”，新来的助手每个夜晚都照例打扰楼上睡着的人，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 annoys。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1973 年，观测员当天就惹恼街上的每一个人；观测站里每一个助手都说这是头一回。（annoyed everybody in the street）
多年以后，观测员仍天没亮就做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（annoys everybody in the street）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯惹恼街上的每一个人这件事本身。（to annoy everybody in the street）
早在 1967 年就有人惹恼街上的每一个人，十一月那天观测记录上的一行字就是证据。（had annoyed everybody in the street）
观测员说过，当天就惹恼街上的每一个人这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（annoying everybody in the street 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻打扰楼上睡着的人，以后再也不要提起。（annoy the people asleep upstairs，祈使句）
answers: In 1973 the observer annoyed everybody in the street on the same day, and every assistant in the observatory said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three nights on, the observer still annoys everybody in the street before dawn without being asked.
My mother said later that to annoy everybody in the street at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had annoyed everybody in the street long before 1980, and the line in the log for November proves it.
Annoying everybody in the street on the same day, the observer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Annoy the people asleep upstairs at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 annoy 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1973 the observer annoyed everybody in the street on the same day, and nobody in the observatory forgot it.
Even now the observer annoys everybody in the street before dawn whenever the observatory asks.
Annoying everybody in the street on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever annoy the people asleep upstairs before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next observatory annoys the people asleep upstairs on the same day every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother annoyed everybody in the street again, and the observatory remembered that half.
